infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Charioteer uses the microphone so you can speak with Thumos. Audio is sent to the coach only while a voice conversation is open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Charioteer uses the camera so you can take a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Charioteer uses your photo library so you can add a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Charioteer reads steps, sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, workouts, and weight so you and Thumos can see how your body is doing. Other people cannot see this.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Charioteer does not write to Apple Health. This message is required because the app includes the HealthKit capability.
